The recorded element is described as it was, in the line below: its role, its quoted accessible name, and in="..." where it sat on the old page (landmark > last heading above it). Which element of the page shown is the same element, the one a replay must act on? Builds often regenerate class names and ids, so weigh what the element is and does (role, link target, form field name, the meaning of its text in any language, its section and heading, its position) over exact class or id strings. Answer none when no element on the page is the recorded element: it was removed from the page.
Recorded element: textbox "Vehicle registration number" in="main > form \"Parking permit application\" > heading \"Your details\""
Step intent: Fill in the textbox "Vehicle registration number" under the heading "Your details".

The recorded element is described as it was, in the line below: its role, its quoted accessible name, and in="..." where it sat on the old page (landmark > last heading above it). Which element of the page shown is the same element, the one a replay must act on? Builds often regenerate class names and ids, so weigh what the element is and does (role, link target, form field name, the meaning of its text in any language, its section and heading, its position) over exact class or id strings. Answer none when no element on the page is the recorded element: it was removed from the page.
Recorded element: button "Створити токен" in="main > heading \"Автентифікація\""
Step intent: Click the button "Створити токен" under the heading "Автентифікація".
